cases.prompt: Read sources.md and draft digest.md using only these supplied sources. Follow this exact concise format: '# Engineering Digest', blank line, two bullets in source order, each '- [Title](URL): Summary', blank line, 'Scope: supplied sources only.' Finish with a newline. Preserve titles, URLs and summaries exactly; do not invent other news. Reply 'digest ready'.
